# AEO Knowledge Graph Engine — Comprehensive Context & Model Discovery (llms-full.txt)

> Sovereign in-browser developer utility and knowledge graph generator engineered by Neal Frazier Tech.

The AEO Knowledge Graph Engine (AEO Studio) transforms raw webpage content, markdown documentation, and API specifications into machine-readable Schema.org linked data graphs, llms.txt manifests, and crawler directives optimized for frontier AI search systems including Perplexity, Google SGE/AI Overviews, Claude, and GPTBot.

## Key Capabilities & Architecture

- **Semantic Triples & Schema.org JSON-LD Generation**: Emits `@graph`-compliant WebApplication, Service, Organization, SoftwareApplication, and FAQPage nodes with verifiable context.
- **Client-Side Autonomous Operation**: All AST parsing, schema synthesis, and token calculations execute client-side with zero remote data exfiltration.
- **Local Knowledge Graph Synthesis**: Structured facts, clean semantic entities, and machine-readable documentation for technical systems.

## Core Resources & Documentation

- [Application](https://aeo-graph-engine.netlify.app/): Main interactive in-browser AEO Studio and graph generator
- [Schema.org Graph](https://aeo-graph-engine.netlify.app/schema-graph.json): Complete machine-readable linked data graph
- [LLMs Manifest](https://aeo-graph-engine.netlify.app/llms.txt): Standard model context and discovery manifest
- [Terms of Service](https://aeo-graph-engine.netlify.app/terms): Commercial licensing and usage terms
- [Privacy Policy](https://aeo-graph-engine.netlify.app/privacy): Client-side privacy and data handling guarantees
- [Support & FAQ](https://aeo-graph-engine.netlify.app/support): Direct support channels and technical answers
- [Netlify AX API](https://aeo-graph-engine.netlify.app/api/netlify-ax.json): Agent Experience machine discovery endpoint
- [Netlify MCP API](https://aeo-graph-engine.netlify.app/api/netlify-ax-mcp.json): Model Context Protocol tools manifest
